ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The route is measured on this trip's own instruments and the fare is then settled under the rules for an upfront-quoted trip.

RIDER — the deviation is established. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00501: 163 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gap, max gap 0.0 s) measures 25.4 km against the 19.6 km optimal recorded at booking on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00501): an excess of 5.8 km, or 29.59%. That passes both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so a deviation exists. It does not reach either materiality test (8.0 km or 50%), so it is not a MATERIAL deviation — no POL-RD-06 uplift and no conduct referral (the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 250 completed trips in any event). The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), so no independent corroboration is needed and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire.

The fare is upfront-quoted. EV-FARE-00501 shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 24.50 and charged_total 39.00. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time lines were fixed at booking, so POL-RD-02 is not run and the 5.8 km excess does not by itself produce a distance refund. Your remedy is POL-RD-11(a): charged_total 39.00 less the quoted fare 24.50 less the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09 (0.00) = SGD 14.50. The two ECP charges (3.00 + 3.00 = 6.00) are off the optimal corridor, whose own ERP is 0.00, so they are not properly chargeable and are already excluded inside the 14.50; they are not refunded a second time on top of it (POL-RD-09(1)). Your pleaded SGD 39.00 overstates the remedy; the amount returned is SGD 14.50, rounded up to the nearest 5 cents.

DRIVER — your traffic explanation ('PIE was crawling') is unsupported. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-00501-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is itself citable but it carries no fact, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13. Because no advisory identifier was named, this is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and the missing artifact does not cap confidence. Your fallback that the rider agreed to the ECP routing also fails: EV-CHAT-00501 holds zero messages, so there is no recorded rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no named road, and POL-RD-04's corroboration test is undecidable on the record — the clause is unavailable and the defence is discarded under POL-RD-08.

The two ERP lines are genuine crossings (the trace's nearest fix lies 0 m from each gantry, inside the 250 m radius) and the airport surcharge of 0.00 is not a defect, so there is no billing-integrity failure under POL-RD-09(4) and no referral on that ground. No profile field has been used to establish anything about this trip (POL-GEN-01). Confidence is 0.90: the deciding facts — the measured excess and the fare arithmetic — are carried by the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown, each at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0, above the 0.70 floor.

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.50 to the rider; the driver receives no compensation (the billed distance equals the traced distance, so POL-RD-04's compensation limb has no shortfall to work on).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this ruling concerns trip TRP-00502 only.

THE MEASUREMENT. POL-RD-01 requires the threshold test on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the rounded 8.8 km convenience copy on the trip record. The trace records 8.77 km against a booked optimal route of 5.60 km. The excess is 3.17 km, or 56.6% of the optimal route: both establishment tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), and the 50% mark is crossed, so the deviation is also MATERIAL. The trace carries no defect for policy purposes (100% coverage, 145 fixes, 10-second cadence, no gaps), so no POL-RD-07(a)-(c) impairment arises and the rider's burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-00502 and their timestamps agree.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The bundle contains no traffic advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-00502-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's account of 'a road works sign near Telok Blangah' is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else; with no advisory on file, POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the account carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and reduces no kilometre of the excess. The chat log is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 gives no reduction; no amendment marker exists under POL-RD-05; and the vehicle was RYDE_PLUS, not a pooled trip under POL-RD-12.

THE MONEY, LINE BY LINE. POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare on the booked optimal route: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 5.60 km + 0.28 x 9.0 min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 11.32. charged_total 17.92 less recomputed_fare 11.32 = 6.60. That is 36.8% of the charge, below the 90% at which POL-RD-02 would itself convert to a full refund, and well above the 0.50 de minimis floor. No ERP, toll or surcharge line exists to be added or carved out (off-optimal-route ERP total 0.00; the trip did not originate at an airport), so nothing is added on top of, or subtracted from, that figure under POL-RD-09.

THE UPLIFT. A MATERIAL deviation makes the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check mandatory. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 4, which is 3 or more, so a repeat deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED on the clause-named field; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used. The deviation is MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, so POL-RD-06(b) applies and the remedy becomes FULL_REFUND of the whole charged_total rather than the POL-RD-02 partial. Printed side by side as the clause requires: POL-RD-02 figure 6.60; uplifted figure 17.92. There are no government-set or third-party pass-through lines to exclude from the uplift.

WHAT I DID NOT GRANT. The rider asks for refunds on three earlier rides and for an examination of the driver's history. No artifact in this bundle describes any other trip, and an assertion citing no evidence ID carries no weight under POL-RD-08, so nothing beyond the 17.92 charged for TRP-00502 can be decided on this file; the history question is answered by the referral below, not by money. The driver's advocate argued the POL-RD-06(b) uplift is discretionary; the clause states the three effects that follow once the pattern is established, and the conditions for limb (b) are met, so the uplift is applied.

WHY THIS IS NOT AN ESCALATION. POL-RD-10 was checked and no trigger fires. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07, the trip identifiers and timestamps match, no charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or trip record, and the refund is 17.92, inside the ordinary limits. The missing advisory is not trigger (5): the driver cited no advisory identifier, and an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one (POL-RD-13(1)). The absent advisory of weight 0.0 carries no fact and its absence is itself citable; every artifact that carries a deciding fact here carries weight 1.0, which is the cap on confidence under POL-GEN-02(2).

FOR THE DRIVER: the referral to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c) is a review of conduct, not a finding that this trip's measurement is wrong; the measurement rests on your own device telemetry. FOR THE RIDER: you are refunded the full 17.92 charged on TRP-00502.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The referral does not displace or delay the monetary ruling.

The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter mentioned in the driver's brief is a near-synonym of the trailing-window field: it is context only under POL-GEN-01, it was not used as a ground, and the finding of deviation rests on this trip's own trace alone. The disputed fare of 17.82 is only partly refunded; the balance, 9.82, stands as correctly charged.

To the rider and the driver: the disputed route deviation is established, and a partial refund of SGD 3.95 is payable to the rider. Here is how I got there and how I dealt with each party's arguments.

THE DEVIATION (both sides agree on the figures, and both are right). The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is the GPS trace, not the rounded trip-record copy. EV-GPS-00518 measures the trip at 7.89 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff; the platform optimal for the booked endpoints (EV-TRIP-00518) is 6.20 km. The excess is 1.69 km, or 27.26% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.80 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is NOT a material deviation — 1.69 km is below the 8.0 km gate and 27.26% is below the 50% gate — so the POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern check is not triggered; in any event the driver profile shows 0 deviation flags in 90 days against 250 completed trips, nowhere near the 3-flag or 5%-of-40 test, so no full-refund uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises.

THE TRACE IS CLEAN. EV-GPS-00518 carries 121 fixes over the 20-minute trip at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0.0 s. It fails none of the POL-RD-07(a)–(c) impairment limbs, so no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required and the deviation may rest on this trace alone.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION. The driver says the road 'avoids two junctions' and is 'a real shortcut when the main road is busy'. That is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle holds one advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00518-01, and it is MISSING: no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is disclosed on both sides (the driver's first claim and the rider's fourth claim each state the impairment). The POL-RD-03 comparison therefore cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID for it, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, and it is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No other escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match (TRP-00518), the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps do not conflict by anything near 10 minutes, and the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling. The case is therefore decided on the money, not held.

NO EXCULPATORY CLAUSE DISPLACES THE RESULT. POL-RD-04 (rider-requested detour) cannot run: EV-CHAT-00518 is empty — 0 messages, both message timestamps null — so there is no rider instruction, and the driver does not assert one. POL-RD-05 (relocated endpoint) has no work to do: both amended timestamps and both amended optimal fields are null, so the booked 6.20 km baseline stands. POL-RD-11 (upfront fares) is closed because the fare model is METERED, and POL-RD-12 (pooled trips) does not apply because the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI with a null solo optimal.

THE REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02), read off the fare breakdown EV-FARE-00518:
  charged_total = 16.13
  recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 6.20 + 0.28 x 10.50) x 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 12.19
  refund = 16.13 - 12.19 = 3.94, rounded UP to SGD 3.95.
There is no ERP gantry, no toll and no airport surcharge line (all 0.00, erp_gantries empty), a waiting_time_fee of 0.00 and a promo_discount of 0.00, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and deducts nothing, and there is no phantom or unmatched line to refer as a billing-integrity finding. The refund of 3.95 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so it is payable rather than dismissed, and at 24.4% of the charged total it does not reach the 90% share that would convert the outcome to a full refund. The outcome is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.95.

PRESENT STATE OF THE LEDGER. The rider recalls that the app 'refunded the difference immediately'. The record does not bear that out: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. That is exactly the state a NO_ACTION ruling would leave, and it is the state this ruling changes — the 3.95 above is the money that moves.

THE POST-TRIP CALL. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00518) shows the only call was a single in-app platform call, placed by the driver after the trip, answered, lasting 190 seconds, routed through the app. No private telephone number was exposed by it. No clause in this category provides a fare remedy or a mandated referral for it, so it produces no referral and no separate payment, and it does not affect the amount above. If the rider still wishes the contact to be looked at, that is a conduct matter for the platform's conduct team and it is recorded here as an open question; it is not a clause-mandated referral and I do not create one.

CONFIDENCE. The facts that decide this case are carried by EV-GPS-00518, EV-TRIP-00518 and EV-FARE-00518, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0; I have set confidence at 0.95. The MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no deciding fact and does not lower the cap.

The shortfall is explained by the rider's own decision: the trip record's dropoff is labelled 'Commonwealth Ave W, rider alighted early' and the trip is logged COMPLETED at 2.7 km against a 5.0 km optimal. A journey cut short by the rider cannot be turned into a driver deviation.

Its separate compensation limb requires the rider to have been billed more than 1.0 km less than the trace records; the fare ledger bills 2.7 km against a 2.71 km trace, a 0.01 km difference, so no driver compensation arises either. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% of the optimal distance. The only ERP line in the ledger is the CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) gantry, SGD 5.00 charged at 08:27:10. The GPS trace passes within 0 metres of that gantry at that exact second and the line is recorded on the optimal route. That makes it a genuine pass-through, so POL-RD-09(4) — which refunds a gantry the trace NEVER passes — has nothing to correct, and POL-RD-09(1)'s 'never counted twice' rule has no second ledger line to reverse: the ledger shows one ERP charge (on_optimal_route_total 5.00, off_optimal_route_total 0.00) and no cash or duplicate entry.

The only properly chargeable line is the single ERP gantry, CTE (Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 towards City), SGD 3.00, which you concede and which the trace genuinely crosses — EV-GPS-00533's nearest fix to the gantry coordinates is 0.0 m at 2026-09-21T09:41:00, and EV-FARE-00533 marks the line on_optimal_route and crossed. The airport surcharge is 0.00 (this trip originated at Yishun MRT, not an airport) and the waiting-time fee is 0.00. The arithmetic is 51.30 − 29.00 − 3.00 = SGD 19.30, the same figure the fare_breakdown's own derived block publishes as pol_rd_11_remedy. The remaining SGD 32.00 (quote plus the ERP you do not dispute) stands. It is a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a full refund, because those lines are properly charged. To the driver: nothing in this ruling is a finding against your driving or your route. EV-GPS-00533 records 14.57 km against a 14.20 km optimal route — 0.37 km, or 2.6% — below both POL-RD-01 gates (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so no deviation is established, no POL-RD-02 recomputation and no POL-RD-06 conduct referral arise, and no driver compensation is due (the billed distance of 14.6 km is not less than the trace; there is no unbilled shortfall). The amount you were charged above the quote is a pricing mismatch on an upfront booking, not extra distance you drove. How I handled the claims. Both advocates' claims are accepted: the driver's that no POL-RD-01 deviation exists and that POL-RD-11 not POL-RD-02 governs; the rider's that the upcharge is recoverable under POL-RD-11(a) at 19.30, that the sole properly chargeable line is the SGD 3.00 ERP, that no material deviation is shown, that the trace is policy-clean, and that the chat log (EV-CHAT-00533, message_count 0) contains no rider detour instruction so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00533-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed and citable as an absence, but the driver asserts no external traffic cause, so under POL-RD-13(1) it is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger; no limb of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires (157 fixes, 10 s cadence, max gap 0.0 s) and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. No referral issues under POL-RD-09(4): the one gantry line is on the optimal route and is genuinely crossed, and the airport surcharge is 0.00, so no phantom or misapplied line exists. The context-only profile fields mentioned in argument (rating, prior_deviation_flags) are not relied on as any ground; the only profile counters used are the citable ones (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d/completed_trips_90d, rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d/deviation_claims_60d_substantiated), and neither triggers anything. To the rider: your real grievance is the 67-minute runtime against the 44-minute estimate, and the train you missed. That is delay, and this policy does not price delay. On a metered fare the time charge (67 min x SGD 0.28 = SGD 18.76) accrues with the time actually spent in the vehicle, and POL-RD-02's recomputation runs only AFTER a distance deviation is established, which it is not. The SGD 30.00 you contested is the consequential cost of the missed connection, not a line of the metered fare, and the fare model carries no head of loss for it — I accept your own concession to that effect, and I cannot award it. The clause is likewise not needed for the money: the off-route ERP, toll and surcharge lines on EV-FARE-00535 are all SGD 0.00, so POL-RD-09(2) adds nothing.

No repeat-deviation uplift (POL-RD-06) is in play: EV-DPROF-00535 records deviation_flags_90d = 0 against completed_trips_90d = 250, and POL-RD-06 is consulted only on a material deviation, which this is not. No phantom gantry or airport-surcharge line exists, so POL-RD-09(4) produces no billing-integrity finding and no referral, and no clause-mandated referral fires. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger applies: all three artifacts carry trip_id TRP-00535 with matching pickup timestamps, the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) (no gaps, 10-second cadence), every fare line has a counterpart in the trace or trip record, and the evidence is not contradictory. Same-trip and burden limbs of POL-RD-08 are met on both sides, so nothing turns on the burden's allocation.

Confidence is 0.90. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — the trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — sits at weight 1.0, well above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation is warranted and the present state of the charge stands.
